html_bullets.point: Geojit Financial Services reiterated a BUY rating on HDFC Bank with a revised target price of Rs. 2,192, citing a 9.2% YoY increase in interest income and a 6.9% YoY rise in profit after tax despite a decline in other income.
HDFC Bank is highlighted as a top holding of Kotak, reflecting confidence in its performance amidst a favorable market environment for banking stocks.
HDFC Bank's earnings estimates for FY27 EPS were marginally raised by 0.3% to Rs 1,332, reflecting positive performance in the recent earnings review.
HDFC Bank is recommended for its stability and robust balance sheet, making it appealing during geopolitical volatility despite recent market corrections.
HDFC Bank reduced its home loan interest rate by 25 basis points to 8.50%, reflecting a response to the repo rate cut.

HDFC Bank reduced its Marginal Cost of Funds-based Lending Rates (MCLR) by up to 15 basis points on select loan tenures, effective May 7, 2025, benefiting borrowers with loans linked to this benchmark.
Sakshi Gupta, Principal Economist at HDFC Bank, indicated that inflation data may provide the Reserve Bank of India with an opportunity to ease interest rates in upcoming monetary policy meetings.
HDFC Bank's market valuation fell by ₹27,062.52 crore to ₹14,46,294.43 crore last week.
HDFC Bank is among the large-cap stocks favored by FIIs, reflecting a trend towards quality-led investments in the financial sector.
HDFC Bank is among the top stock holdings for both FIIs and DIIs, with FIIs holding 89.2 billion and DIIs holding 50.1 billion.

HDFC Bank's MD and CEO Amitabh Chaudhry noted that the retail asset quality for unsecured products is normalizing, with a stabilization in the card portfolio, although personal loans may take longer to improve due to previous credit overextension issues.
HDFC Bank is expected to drive earnings growth in the banking sector, benefiting from the reversal of regulatory curbs on lending to non-banking financial companies (NBFCs).
HDFC Bank currently owns 94.54% of HDB Financial Services and may need to reduce its stake to comply with proposed RBI regulations, with potential operational challenges in merging HDB into itself.
HDFC Bank will participate in the sale of shares in Yes Bank to Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, contributing to the 20% stake acquisition.
HDFC Bank reported a net profit in the range of 8-10 billion during the latest trailing 12 months, showcasing its robust profitability in the Indian market.
HDFC Bank's American Depository Receipts fell more than 4% overnight, but the bank's stock has climbed around 9% in the past month following a strong March quarter performance.
HDFC Bank reported a significant increase in loan write-offs, totaling part of the ₹80,568 crore in FY25, compared to ₹74,931 crore in FY24, which has helped lower its NPA ratios.
